name: task-manager
description: Lets Claude Code agents claim, work, and hand off tasks in the self-hosted AI task manager: MCP tools over its REST API, the task-workflow skill, and a SessionStart hook that lists the tasks you still hold.

api_url.title: Task manager API URL
api_url.description: Base URL of the REST API, including /api/v1.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who you act as, sent as X-Actor on every request: agent:<name>, lowercase.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Only if the server sets API_TOKEN (self-hosted deployments). Leave empty for a local API.

server_path.title: MCP server path
server_path.description: Absolute path to apps/mcp/dist/index.js in your task manager checkout. Leave empty when the plugin is installed from that checkout's local marketplace.
